findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "cvl_behavior_report" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Friction for a window: the pages people spend time on and scroll through, the rage clicks and dead clicks classified from the click rows the tag already stores,…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cvl_crawl_start, cvl_public_seo_scan, cvl_public_agent_readiness · Private data: cvl_whoami, cvl_change_apply, cvl_propose, cvl_error_fix_shipped, cvl_crawl_start · Public sink: cvl_behavior_report, cvl_check_claim · Destructive: cvl_change_undo, cvl_remember, cvl_operator_run, cvl_run_crawl, cvl_seo_untrack_keywords, cvl_seo_run_flow, cvl_public_seo_scan, cvl_public_seo_scan_result, cvl_search_tools, cvl_call_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cvl_crawl_start, cvl_public_seo_scan, cvl_public_agent_readiness · Private data: cvl_whoami, cvl_change_apply, cvl_propose, cvl_error_fix_shipped, cvl_crawl_start · Public sink: cvl_behavior_report, cvl_check_claim · Destructive: cvl_change_undo, cvl_remember, cvl_operator_run, cvl_run_crawl, cvl_seo_untrack_keywords, cvl_seo_run_flow, cvl_public_seo_scan, cvl_public_seo_scan_result, cvl_search_tools, cvl_call_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
